about: Woolwich Township is a rural municipality in Waterloo Region, Ontario, covering Elmira, St. Jacobs, Breslau, and surrounding Mennonite farmland north of Waterloo. It is not a city: villages and countryside sit among fields, markets, and the Conestogo River. St. Jacobs’ farmers’ market and Mennonite heritage draw regional visitors. About 27,000 people live in Woolwich Township.
